## Hinge question · A value on the boundary {#l3-hinge }

```{=html}
<div data-module="hinge" data-correct="2" class="hinge">
<p class="hinge-question">The classes are 11 ≤ <span data-math="x">x</span> &lt; 12, 12 ≤ <span data-math="x">x</span> &lt; 13 and 13 ≤ <span data-math="x">x</span> &lt; 14. Where does <span data-math="x">x</span> = 13 belong?</p>
<div class="hinge-toolbar"><div class="time" role="timer" aria-label="Time remaining">1:00</div><div class="toolbar"><label>Seconds <select class="timer-duration" aria-label="Question duration"><option>30</option><option>45</option><option selected>60</option><option>90</option><option>120</option></select></label><button class="timer-start primary">Start</button><button class="reset-question">Reset</button></div></div><div class="choices"><button class="choice" data-answer="1" aria-pressed="false"><b>1</b><span>12 ≤ <span data-math="x">x</span> &lt; 13 only</span></button><button class="choice" data-answer="2" aria-pressed="false"><b>2</b><span>13 ≤ <span data-math="x">x</span> &lt; 14 only</span></button><button class="choice" data-answer="3" aria-pressed="false"><b>3</b><span>Both of the last two classes</span></button><button class="choice" data-answer="4" aria-pressed="false"><b>4</b><span>Neither class</span></button></div>
<div class="hinge-bottom"><p>Fist on chest. Think quietly. On “show”, hold up 1–4 fingers.</p><button class="reveal-answer primary">Reveal answer</button></div>
<div class="hinge-explanation" hidden>2. The symbol ≤ includes the lower boundary and &lt; excludes the upper boundary. Option 1 chooses the wrong side; option 3 double-counts; option 4 creates a gap.</div>
</div>
```

::: notes
Use 30–45 seconds. Everyone starts with a fist on their chest, then holds up 1–4 fingers together on your “show” cue. Collect responses before revealing.

Correct answer: 2. $13$ belongs to $13 \le x < 14$: include the lower boundary and exclude the upper boundary.

- 1: includes an excluded upper boundary.
- 3: assigns the value to both classes and double-counts it.
- 4: excludes the value from both classes and creates a gap.

Ready: ask where $x=12$ belongs, then proceed.
Divided: ask pairs to translate each inequality into words, then re-poll on “show”.
Further explanation needed: revisit the interactive boundary slide, set the value to 13, and re-poll before moving on.
:::
